releases.summary: Small fixes to piped `fcs` paths and MCP totals. No re-index or config change is needed.

Fixes from the 2026-10-15 review of what fcs promises against what it does. Paging is now consistent, busy files show their best hits, several silent cut-offs now say so, and the server keeps its index current by default. Upgrading:** file watching is now on by default. A config without a `watch`...

Search limits are measured, raised and configurable. Page 1 of a search for a common word now holds most of what an unlimited search would rank first, and MCP agents can page through every hit. Upgrading:** no re-index is needed. Page 1 of a broad search now ranks different (better) hits than 0.1...
Watch mode keeps answering searches on very large trees, and Python projects whose imports were listed as external now resolve. Re-index a Python project to pick up the import fixes.

Existing indexes are rebuilt once on the first start.** The on-disk index format is now version 8 (case-insensitive search folds case like `rg -i`), and symbols are re-extracted for the new reference kinds and Python references; the rebuild also picks up the dependency-graph fixes for TypeScript,...

Search works differently in this release.** Plain-text search is now a literal, like `rg -F`: several words are one phrase, quotes and a leading `-` are part of the text, and the `-term` exclusion and quoted phrases are gone. In the web UI, a regex ignores case unless MATCH CASE is on. See Change...
Same changes as 0.15.0, with the version number set correctly. The v0.15.0 tag was pushed before the version bump, so its binaries report 0.14.0 and its release has no changelog notes. Use 0.15.1.
